extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized keeping their doctors. The agent scheduled a plan review for 2 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: The agent made a statement that was flagged as materially misleading: 'Honestly, this is the best plan in Pasco County, nobody beats it.' Consider rephrasing this to focus on the plan's benefits rather than making a comparative claim.
